report.answer: Low-level SSE streaming is implemented in src/core/streaming.ts (Stream<Item> class + _iterSSEMessages/SSEDecoder), invoked via src/internal/parse.ts's defaultParseResponse which calls Stream.fromSSEResponse whenever a request is made with `stream: true`. Higher-level convenience streaming wrappers live in src/lib/ (EventStream.ts, ChatCompletionStream.ts, ResponseStream in src/lib/responses/ResponseStream.ts, AssistantStream.ts). Public API methods that route into streaming: `client.chat.completions.create({stream:true})` and `client.responses.create({stream:true})`/`client.responses.retrieve(id,{stream:true})` (both set `stream` on the request and return `Stream<Item>` via defaultParseResponse), plus dedicated helper methods `client.chat.completions.stream()` → ChatCompletionStream.createChatCompletion and `client.responses.stream()` → ResponseStream.createResponse, which build on top of core Stream.
